newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ says to issue A$200 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: ANZ says to issue A$200 mln bond.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said it will issue A$200 million under a newly-established domestic fixed rate transferable deposit programme.
The issue will mature on July 15, 2000, and, subject to market conditions, will be launched and priced on Wednesday, Juen 4, with settlement on June 10.
The issue will be lead-managed by ANZ Investment Bank and will mark ANZ's return to the domestic corporate bond market.
Dealers to the issue will be Bankers Trust Australia, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and SBC Warburg.
The last fixed rate domestic bond issue by the ANZ was in December 1992, the bank said.
